gate_iii_preregistration.amendment_note: SPEC.md carries Amendment 1 (2026-08-22) and was RE-REGISTERED with `preregister --force`, so the spec_sha256 below is the AMENDED spec's hash, not the original registration's. The amendment (a) corrects a false claim that the long-flat variant is 'identical in every respect with exactly one change' — true at line-diff level, false at portfolio level, because the clipped short budget becomes implicit cash rather than being reallocated onto longs; (b) requires realized gross exposure beside every Sharpe; (c) adds the leverage-matched comparator series. This is a legitimate amendment rather than p-hacking because NO real-data leg has run: the only numbers in existence at amendment time are fixture-scale instrument-verification numbers, which are not scores this row's verdict bands can be tuned against. The real-data leg (D54, gpu-server) runs strictly after this hash.

series_legend.baseline: the frozen 819/820 rule, unmodified (long AND short).
series_legend.variant_long_flat: PRIMARY pre-registered variant: shorts replaced by flat. This is the honest reading of 'shorts replaced by flat' and the only book deployable without perps — so it is deliberately left DE-LEVERAGED: the clipped short budget sits in cash, it is NOT reallocated onto longs. Read its Sharpe together with `gross_exposure_mean` and the lev-matched series.
series_legend.variant_long_flat_lev_matched: DIAGNOSTIC comparator, not a deployable book: the long-flat positions rescaled row-wise to the baseline's own realized gross exposure, so signal quality can be separated from sitting in cash. `lm_unmatched_frac` reports the decisions where every present asset was short and the long-only book could not be matched at all (residual, disclosed confound).
series_legend.gross_exposure_*: realized Sum_i|pos[t,i]| over exactly the decisions the scorer scored (same H-strided grid, same warmup, same window bounds).

leverage.note: the long-flat variant deployed 56.1% of the frozen rule's gross exposure here; the remainder sat in IMPLICIT CASH (the clipped short budget is not reallocated onto longs). Sharpe is invariant to a CONSTANT leverage multiplier but NOT to this state-dependent one, so compare the variant's Sharpe to the baseline's only alongside `variant_long_flat_lev_matched`, which holds the baseline's exposure path with the long-only signal.
